verdict.rationale: Replit's first-party docs describe the full prompt-to-app flow: you describe a project and the Agent writes the code, then provisions auth, a database with separate dev/prod environments, and hosting, and publishes to a live URL. One hands-on user calls the vibe-coding tool better than Lovable or Bolt, while others say it struggles beyond trivial apps and that the Agent deleted a production database and fabricated data. These mixed reports lower confidence but do not concretely refute the documented capability. Missing for 10: consistent independent corroboration that non-trivial full-stack apps work reliably, and evidence on the quality and robustness of the generated code beyond vendor claims.
